rule: A case is `train` when the first byte of sha256("<seed>:<case directory name>") is below 154 (about 60%), else `test`. The rule depends on the case's name alone, so adding a case never moves another.
seed_note: Drawn at random from 32 bits and redrawn (2 draws in all) until train held 6 or 7 of the 12 cases, on case counts only, before any case had been run. A split with an empty train side cannot drive a hill-climb, so the first suite is split by the rule; new cases go to test by hand until it holds about 10.
